description: DirMO-24 feat30 (team recipe, mean of seeds 42/1/2) with loss weights derived from the board score S (w = a + (1 - a) n c(y) per lead, a = TIMSE/(MSE+TIMSE) from 4-fold out-of-fold errors of the training rows), floored by the 4x-above-550 km/s rule: w = max(w, 4 if y >= 550 else 1), mean 1 per lead. Motivation: dirmo_24_feat30_metricweight (no floor) lost to 4x on TIMSE, mostly at 49-72 h, with a lower level. Lab check (jsy301 round HW, xgboost 3.4.1, 5 windows 2023-07..2025-12, raw truth, 3 seeds; gate written after that board result, so a hypothesis): high-speed windows 2025 -0.71 % vs 4x [CI -1.14,-0.34], quiet windows -0.25 % [CI -0.67,+0.31] (2023-H2 +0.16 %), all 5 windows -0.55 %. Not chosen by any board number.

data.rebuilt_rows: origins without a team row: image-free columns recomputed with the team formulas; image columns from the newest team row (delta <= 2 h unchanged, else aged + stale rule)
data.training_rows: train.npz (3-hourly) + official.npz rows on the 3-hour grid

hyperparameters.base_score: block mean of the training targets (scalar)

loss_weight.rule: w_il = max(a_l + (1 - a_l) n c_l(y_il), 4 if y_il >= 550 else 1), mean 1 per lead; a_l = TIMSE_l / (MSE_l + TIMSE_l)

hyperparameters.strategy: DirMO-24-Top30, metric-derived loss weights floored at 4x@550
